changelog:
- Eliminated YouTube Video Black Screen / Buffering: Removed false-positive stream query interception and video seeking manipulation so videos play immediately.
- User Overlay & Cookie Defusers: Restored mutation-observer based defusers for consent banners, GDPR dialogs, and anti-adblock modals.
- Targeted Social Network Ad Interception: Filter explicit ad endpoints on Instagram, Facebook, and Reddit without interfering with feed boot APIs.
- Complete 3rd-Party Cookie Protection: Disabled 3rd-party cookies across all browsing contexts.
